# BNG Calculator: Biodiversity Net Gain Calculator (2026, Defra v4.0)

> Free BNG calculator aligned to the Statutory Biodiversity Metric v4.0 (JP039). Sizes the biodiversity units a site needs, prices them as statutory credits from the GOV.UK price list (last updated 2 June 2026), and prices off-site units at the user's own quote, since off-site units have no public rate card.
